STS2BALANCEMOD-ENABLE_EVENT_LEAVE_OPTION:
Adds a Leave option to Bugslayer, Tinker Time, and The Future of Potions.

Enabled by default. Changes apply the next time one of these events is opened. In multiplayer, every player must use the same value.
STS2BALANCEMOD-ENABLE_INFESTED_PRISM_REW:
Replaces Infested Prism's Vital Spark mechanic and original move set with the mod's four-turn cycle and Infection mechanic.

Enabled by default. Changes apply the next time an Infested Prism combat begins. In multiplayer, every player must use the same value.
